court: Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit

issues.label: Section 1252(f)(1) reach over declaratory relief
issues.why: The court must decide whether the jurisdictional bar on class-wide injunctions also precludes class-wide declaratory relief affecting section 1226(a).

issues.label: Availability of class-wide declaratory judgment
issues.why: The court must determine whether declaratory relief is appropriate given that class-wide injunctive relief is barred post-Aleman Gonzalez.

issues.label: Rule 23(b)(2) certification propriety
issues.why: The court must decide whether a (b)(2) class remains cohesive and proper when only declaratory, not injunctive, relief is potentially available.

issues.label: Whether declaratory relief circumvents 1252(f)(1)
issues.why: The court must assess if entering declaratory relief effectively grants the injunctive relief Congress stripped from lower courts.

issues.label: Mootness of named plaintiff's claim
issues.why: Onosamba-Ohindo was released, so the court must determine whether his individual claim remains live.

issues.label: Inherently-transitory exception to mootness
issues.why: The court must decide whether the transitory nature of immigration detention preserves the class representative's standing despite release.

issues.label: Standing of class representative
issues.why: The court must confirm the named plaintiff has a concrete, redressable injury to represent the class.

issues.label: Due process burden of proof
issues.why: The court must determine whether the Fifth Amendment requires the government to bear the burden by clear and convincing evidence in bond hearings.

issues.label: Deference to BIA precedents
issues.why: The court must weigh Matter of Guerra and Matter of Barreiros allocating the burden to noncitizens against constitutional claims.

issues.label: Ability-to-pay consideration requirement
issues.why: The court must decide whether due process requires IJs to consider a detainee's financial ability when setting bond.

issues.label: Alternatives-to-detention consideration requirement
issues.why: The court must decide whether due process requires IJs to consider non-bond conditions of release.

issues.label: Clear-and-convincing standard justification
issues.why: The court must determine the constitutionally required standard of proof for continued civil detention.

issues.label: Effect of Aleman Gonzalez on remedies
issues.why: The court must apply the Supreme Court's holding to define what remedial options remain available.

issues.label: Redressability of declaratory judgment
issues.why: The court must assess whether a bare declaration would actually redress class members' alleged injuries.

issues.label: Prejudice showing for post-hearing detainees
issues.why: The court must consider whether individualized prejudice requirements affect class definition and cohesiveness.

issues.label: Prudential/discretionary declaratory-judgment factors
issues.why: Under the Declaratory Judgment Act the court retains discretion whether issuing a declaration serves a useful purpose.

issues.label: Ripeness of class members' claims
issues.why: The court must ensure the pre-hearing class members present ripe, live controversies for adjudication.

issues.label: Voluntary cessation and government compliance
issues.why: The government's temporary compliance with revised procedures may bear on mootness and continuing controversy.

issues.label: Habeas versus class-action procedural interaction
issues.why: The court must reconcile individual habeas relief with class-wide declaratory relief mechanisms.

issues.label: Scope of proposed declaration
issues.why: The court must evaluate whether the requested declaration's specific terms are legally warranted and appropriately tailored.
